name: IEEE118-derived 54 units x 24 hours x 10 scenarios
scope: Project extension of data/ for stochastic experiments. Units are copied byte for byte from data/units.json; scenario loads are generated by this script and are not IEEE source data.

generator.script_hash_format: SHA256 of the script with LF line endings

scenario_model: load_st = round(base_load_t * f_s * (1 + e_st), 2); f_s = clip(1 + 0.02 z, 0.95, 1.03); e_st = clip(0.01 z, -0.02, 0.02); z standard normal; 10 equiprobable scenarios
acceptance: peak load <= 0.98 * sum(pmax) and no reachable-output shortfall when every unit is on from the earliest hour its initial minimum down time allows; otherwise redraw
model_choices: shift range narrowed from the +-30% of Mahroo & Kargarian (TPWRS 2026): the fleet has 7.5% headroom over the base peak and hour 1 is ramp limited
